pilot.description: paired comparison pilot with 200 warmup + 400 measured assignments, total 600 cycles

main-v2.description: expanded main series with 300 warmup + 3000 measured assignments, total 3300 cycles

primary_effect: paired change in successful CreateSMContext share for SMF3
gate: all sessions accounted for, no establishment failure, fresh discovery proven
series_selection_rule: match only within the same series_id and identical warmup, cycles, hashes, timeout and resource configuration; never merge pilot and main runs in one effect table
note: A protocol is not evidence that these runs have been completed.

sequential_rule.decision: After stage 1 choose one fixed additional sample size per insufficient cell from stage-1 variance; do not repeatedly peek at ordinary confidence intervals
sequential_rule.intervals: Stage-1 95% intervals exploratory; independent confirmation data reported separately; pooled ordinary CIs not claimed selection-valid
